name: MP Mus

paper.title: Probing for Exoplanets Hiding in Dusty Debris Disks: Disk Imaging, Characterization, and Exploration with HST/STIS Multi-roll Coronagraphy

notes: MP Mus (PDS 66 field neighbour; = CPD-68 1894, K1Ve): a relatively old (~7-17 Myr) but still gas-rich, near-face-on accreting disk. Added 2026-07-09 to complete the Schneider et al. 2014 STIS GO-12228 gallery (item was the one detected disk absent from the atlas).
